_comment: Extra AI providers. Edit this file and the app sees it immediately (no restart). All endpoints are OpenAI-compatible. Details come from the community 'awesome free LLM APIs' lists and are self-reported, so limits and model names can be out of date: Aqua checks real model names when you connect.

steps: Create a Cohere account.
Open API keys and copy the free Trial key.
Paste it below.
info.note: Listed as about 20 requests a minute and 1,000 calls a month, for non-commercial use.

steps: Create a Z AI account (overseas phone numbers are accepted).
Open the API keys page and create a key.
Paste it below.
info.note: Free models allow about one request at a time.

steps: Open GitHub token settings and create a fine-grained personal access token.
Give it the Models permission (read).
Paste the token below.
info.note: Meant for prototyping, with low rate limits. If the model names fail, use Settings, Load the model list.

steps: Create a Hugging Face account.
Create an access token with inference permission.
Paste it below.
info.note: Free accounts get only a small monthly credit; after that you need billing.

steps: Create an Aion Labs account.
Create an API key in the dashboard.
Paste it below.
info.note: Listed as 15 requests a minute and 20K tokens a day, so it runs out quickly.

steps: Create an AxForge account.
Create an API key.
Paste it below.
info.note: The list says 3M tokens per 30 days, shared across models, and that prompts are not stored or used for training. That is the provider's own claim.

steps: Sign up with a GitHub account (at least 30 days old, so no card is needed).
Create an API key.
Paste it below.
info.note: Signing up with Google may ask for a card.

info.sub: 10K neurons a day. Needs your account ID.
steps: Create a free Cloudflare account and copy your Account ID.
Create an API token with the Workers AI permission.
Paste your Account ID, a colon, then the token, like  ACCOUNTID:TOKEN  (in Paste keys write  cloudflare: ACCOUNTID:TOKEN). Aqua puts the Account ID in the address for you.
info.note: Some models need a paid plan.

steps: Create a Requesty account and an API key.
Paste it below.
In Settings, Load the model list and pick a free model.
info.note: Gateway run by a small operator. It sends your prompts to third parties, and some free models may keep prompts or train on them.

info.sub: Many open models. Account on modelscope.cn.
steps: Create a ModelScope account (the site is mostly Chinese; a browser translator helps).
Open your access token page and create a token.
Paste it in Paste keys as  modelscope: your-token  and Aqua picks the models.
info.note: Listed on the awesome-free-llm-apis page. The endpoint address was written from memory: if the test fails, check ModelScope's API-Inference docs.

info.sub: Free small models. Account on siliconflow.cn.
steps: Create a SiliconFlow account.
Open the API keys page and create a key.
Paste it in Paste keys as  siliconflow: your-key  and Aqua picks the models.
info.note: Listed on the awesome-free-llm-apis page. The endpoint address was written from memory: if the test fails, check SiliconFlow's docs (some accounts use api.siliconflow.com).

info.note: Kilo Code now answers 401 without a signed-in token. The community list still says no key is needed, so it is out of date.

info.sub: Only gpt-oss:20b works without a key.
steps: Nothing to sign up for.
Press Enable below.
info.note: Checked on 2026-11-26: gpt-oss:20b answered and called a tool without a key. Other models there need a key. It is rate limited and anonymous, so your prompts are public: never send secrets.
